# Manual status (`source_type: manual`)

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-probe-refs.ts from packages/probe-config. Do not edit by hand. -->

No probe. Status is set by hand with setManualMetricStatus, in the console, or by an open incident on a service that contains the metric.

- Runs on: Observer Cloud, no agent (do not set `agent`)
- Thresholds: not used
- testProbe: not supported

## Value and unit

- no unit: no measured value; the status is set by hand or by an open incident

## source_config fields

None. `source_config` is `{}`.

## Rules

- No agent and no thresholds.
- Use it for signals nothing measures, such as a vendor's own status.

## Example

```yaml
source_type: manual
source_config: {}
```
